text.textPath: ATLANTIS — false heaven, social illusions, techno-faith
03 · HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT
THE CENTER — moral crucible, repair, recurrence

svg.text: a phrase he speaks without pausing — one building, one word per lot
a public building — a line six or more other mouths also sing (numbered)
white ground — where he breathes: alleys, streets, the public realm
a piazza — a breath of 0.6 s or more
gardens — ground the poem did not build on
after Nolli, 1748 · on Plato’s ring plan, Critias 113–117
scale of seconds of the poet’s voice
